review_scope: Read-only static transport review of the exact assembled private profile-only packet and embedded wrapper ZIP. The wrapper was parsed and its literals inspected without execution. No packet regeneration, provider action, fit, prediction, grade, or score was performed.
findings: The assembly receipt, checksum manifest, controller builder admission, source-review receipt, and exact source-review map all match their declared SHA-256 values. All 19 packet files match the assembly byte counts and hashes, and the parsed SHA256SUMS entries equal the assembly packet map exactly.

The wrapper's embedded ZIP was recovered from Python AST literal assignments without executing the wrapper. Its SHA-256 matches the embedded constant. The ZIP contains 18 unique names, exactly the expected bundle payload set; every extracted member hash matches the wrapper hash map and the corresponding packet file. All names are safe relative paths and no member is a symlink. The 15 independently reviewed source-map members are all included.

The included pinned source archive has 51 safe regular-file/directory entries, no absolute or traversal paths, no symlinks or hard links, and its regular files stay within scripts/train_rnn.py and src/wnn/.

Kaggle metadata identifies a private Python script at vladkochetov07/e520-profile-v9-memory-domains with profile_kernel_bundle.py as its sole code entrypoint. The wrapper checks the ZIP digest and every extracted payload hash before import and uses a fresh fixed v9 extraction directory.

The frozen plan is profile-only: fit, checkpoint writes, prediction export, grading, and scoring are disabled. The packet binds the reviewed 1,700-second worker wall cap and 3,400-second provisional quota cap. external_review.json is byte-identical to the controller's packet-build admission, which itself binds the independent source PASS; that admission explicitly does not authorize provider push.

verification.assembly_and_manifest: 19/19 packet files and manifest entries exactly match the frozen assembly map.
verification.embedded_zip: 18/18 unique safe payload members match local packet bytes, wrapper SHA map, and embedded archive SHA.
verification.reviewed_source_coverage: 15/15 source-review map entries are present in the embedded ZIP.
verification.metadata_and_gates: Private slug, one script entrypoint, profile-only flags, extraction path, and worker/quota caps match the exact plan and assembly.
verification.support_execution: Bounded 1-CPU, 1.5-GB, 120-second local static verification; wrapper not executed.

limitations_and_conditions: This PASS binds only the exact assembled bytes listed above and is transport review, not a provider execution authorization or evidence of successful profile execution.

Before push, the operator/controller must obtain fresh exact-slug, quota/account-reserve, campaign-headroom, source-seal, hardware/runtime, and target-registration evidence and record a separate pre-push admission. Provider status alone is not profile success; terminal logs and outputs require reconciliation.
